hook_machinery.runtime_dependency: Pinned Endstone0.11.10 bundles funchook1.1.3. Its functions are local ELF symbols, resolved only after full runtime and function SHA256 admission. No separate funchook library installed.
hook_machinery.abi: Actual pinned Linux headers independently compiled: save hidden return first, virtual slot51/408; changed slot35/280; setter slot14/112. Runtime SDK setter caller independently disassembled.
hook_machinery.lifetime: Plugin pinned with RTLD_NODELETE before installation. Callback state and trampolines intentionally survive until process exit. Disable clears watched pointer; callbacks only compare pointer values and forward originals. No production unload/thread-safety qualification.

bundle_negative_control.finding: Vanilla extraction changed bundle saved contents in place without a watched slot19 setter/change increment. Three-hook epochs alone are insufficient to detect all held-content mutations.

native_saves.raw_snapshot_during_cursor_gestures: Intermediate snapshots intentionally contain only native inventory state; they are not full cursor-plus-inventory transaction snapshots.

limitations: No complete mutation/ABA or exclusive held-item identity qualification: observed bundle extraction bypasses the watched slot hooks.
No save suppression, partial-write barrier, rollback, durable journal integration or crash recovery tests.
Only an identical pre-existing six-stone SDK replacement was performed by the probe; no live reconstruction writer or item editor.
No unknown native signature, guessed Windows offset, second client or Windows execution used.
Raw item/book NBT, account identifiers, server binaries and disassembly remain private.
